```{r}
#Przewalutowanie
Car_sale_ads_cleaned_drive_transmission_imputed <- Car_sale_ads_cleaned_drive_transmission_imputed %>%
  mutate(
    PricePLN = ifelse(
      Currency == "PLN",
      Price,
      round(Price * 4.23)
    )
  )
Car_sale_ads_cleaned_drive_transmission_imputed <- Car_sale_ads_cleaned_drive_transmission_imputed %>%
  relocate(PricePLN, .after = Price)
```

```{r}
df_brand <- Car_sale_ads_cleaned_drive_transmission_imputed %>%
  count(Vehicle_brand, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(perc = n / sum(n)) %>%
  arrange(desc(n)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 20)
```

```{r}
ggplot(df_brand, aes(x = reorder(Vehicle_brand, n), y = n, fill = n)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(perc * 100, 1), "%")),
            hjust = -0.1, size = 4.5, fontface = "bold") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#6ECFF6", high = "#005B96") +
  labs(
    title = "TOP 20 najpopularniejszych marek samochodów",
    subtitle = "Z procentowym udziałem w całej bazie ogłoszeń",
    x = "Marka pojazdu",
    y = "Liczba modeli",
    fill = "Liczba"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  expand_limits(y = max(df_brand$n) * 1.15)
```

```{r}
df_bins <- Car_sale_ads_cleaned_drive_transmission_imputed %>%
  mutate(
    Price_trimmed = ifelse(PricePLN > 200000, 200001, PricePLN),
    Price_bin = cut(
      Price_trimmed,
      breaks = c(seq(0, 200000, by = 20000), Inf),
      labels = c(
        "0–20k", "20–40k", "40–60k", "60–80k", "80–100k",
        "100–120k", "120–140k", "140–160k", "160–180k", "180–200k", ">200k"
      ),
      include.lowest = TRUE,
      right = FALSE
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(Price_bin) %>%
  summarise(N = n()) %>%
  mutate(
    percent = N / sum(N),
    percent_label = paste0(round(percent * 100, 1), "%")
  )
```

```{r}
# Wykres
ggplot(df_bins, aes(x = Price_bin, y = N, fill = percent)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = percent_label), vjust = -0.5, size = 4) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#6baed6", high = "#08306b", name = "Udział %", labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    title = "Liczba ogłoszeń ze względu na cenę (PLN)",
    x = "Przedział cenowy",
    y = "Liczba ogłoszeń"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "right",
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )
```

```{r}
df_drive_clean <- Car_sale_ads_cleaned_drive_transmission_imputed %>%
  mutate(
    Drive_clean = case_when(
      grepl("^4x4", Drive, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "4x4",
      Drive %in% c("AWD", "All-wheel drive")   ~ "4x4",
      TRUE                                    ~ Drive
    ),
    Drive_clean = fct_recode(
      Drive_clean,
      "4x4" = "4x4",
      "Przednia oś" = "Front wheels",
      "Tylna oś" = "Rear wheels"
    )
  )
```

```{r}
pie_plot <- function(data, var, title, legend_title = "") {
  
  df <- data %>%
    count({{ var }}) %>%
    mutate(
      percent = n / sum(n),
      percent_label = paste0(round(percent * 100, 1), "%")
    )
  
  ggplot(df, aes(x = "", y = n, fill = {{ var }})) +
    geom_col(width = 1, color = "white") +
    coord_polar(theta = "y") +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = percent_label),
      position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
      color = "white",
      fontface = "bold",
      size = 4.5
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = blue_palette_dark,
      name = legend_title
    ) +
    labs(title = title) +
    theme_void(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "right"
    )
}
```

```{r}
# Przygotowanie danych
dane <- Car_sale_ads_cleaned_drive_transmission_imputed %>%
  select(Power_HP, PricePLN) %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  filter(
    between(
      PricePLN,
      quantile(PricePLN, 0.01),
      quantile(PricePLN, 0.85)
    ),
    between(
      Power_HP,
      quantile(Power_HP, 0.01),
      quantile(Power_HP, 0.99)
    )
  )


# Wykres: cena vs moc silnika (bez obserwacji skrajnych)
ggplot(dane, aes(x = Power_HP, y = PricePLN)) +
  geom_hex(bins = 45) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    se = FALSE,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  scale_fill_stepsn(
    colours = c(
      "#c6dbef",  # < 100  (jasny, ale widoczny)
      "#9ecae1",  # 100–499
      "#6baed6",  # 500–999
      "#4292c6",  # 1000–1999
      "#2171b5",  # 2000–4999
      "#084594"   # ≥ 5000 (bardzo wysoka gęstość)
    ),
    breaks = c(1, 100, 500, 1000, 2000, 5000),
    labels = c(
      "< 100",
      "100–499",
      "500–999",
      "1000–1999",
      "2000–4999",
      "≥ 5000"
    ),
    name = "Liczba ogłoszeń"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
  labs(
    title = "Zależność ceny samochodu od mocy silnika",
    x = "Moc silnika (KM)",
    y = "Cena pojazdu (PLN)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  )



```

```{r}
# Procentowy spadek cen: nowe vs używane
# Wybrane popularne modele samochodów

# 1. Filtrowanie danych
models_selected <- Car_sale_ads_cleaned_drive_transmission_imputed %>%
  filter(
    (Vehicle_brand == "Opel" & Vehicle_model == "Astra") |
    (Vehicle_brand == "Audi" & Vehicle_model == "A4") |
    (Vehicle_brand == "BMW" & Vehicle_model == "Seria 3") |
    (Vehicle_brand == "Volkswagen" & Vehicle_model == "Golf") |
    (Vehicle_brand == "Volkswagen" & Vehicle_model == "Passat")
  ) %>%
  filter(Condition %in% c("New", "Used")) %>%
  mutate(
    Model_full = paste(Vehicle_brand, Vehicle_model)
  )

# 2. Mediany cen + procentowy spadek
price_comparison <- models_selected %>%
  group_by(Model_full, Condition) %>%
  summarise(
    median_price = median(PricePLN, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = Condition,
    values_from = median_price
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    price_diff = New - Used,
    price_diff_pct = round((price_diff / New) * 100, 1)
  )

# 3. Wykres: różne odcienie w zależności od % spadku
ggplot(
  price_comparison,
  aes(
    x = reorder(Model_full, price_diff_pct),
    y = price_diff_pct,
    fill = price_diff_pct
  )
) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = paste0(price_diff_pct, "%")),
    hjust = -0.1,
    size = 4
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "#c6dbef",
    high = "#08306b"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Procentowa różnica cen pomiędzy samochodami nowymi i używanymi",
    subtitle = "Pięć najpopularniejszych modeli samochodów",
    x = "Model pojazdu",
    y = "Używane modele tańsze względem nowych modeli (%)",
    fill = "Spadek ceny (%)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom"
  ) +
  expand_limits(y = max(price_comparison$price_diff_pct) * 1.15)
```

```{r}
nonparametric_test <- function(data, response, group) {
  
  formula <- as.formula(paste(response, "~", group))
  k <- nlevels(data[[group]])
  
  cat("\n=====================================\n")
  cat("ZMIENNA:", group, "\n")
  cat("LICZBA POZIOMÓW:", k, "\n")
  cat("=====================================\n\n")
  
  # 2 grupy → Wilcoxon
  if (k == 2) {
    test <- wilcox.test(formula, data = data)
    print(test)
    
    eff <- wilcox_effsize(data, formula)
    print(eff)
    
  } 
  
  # >= 3 grupy → Kruskal + Dunn
  else if (k > 2) {
    kw <- kruskal.test(formula, data = data)
    print(kw)
    
    eff <- kruskal_effsize(data, formula)
    print(eff)
    
    if (kw$p.value < 0.05) {
      cat("\nPost-hoc Dunn (Bonferroni):\n")
      dunn <- dunn_test(
        data = data,
        formula,
        p.adjust.method = "bonferroni"
      )
      print(dunn)
    }
  }
}
```

```{r}
nonparametric_test(Car_sale_ads_cleaned_drive_transmission_imputed, "PricePLN", "Transmission")
```

